title: Reach Local Customers with Local Service Ads - Google Ads

facts.fact: Google states that with Local Services Ads, advertisers pay for customers rather than clicks.
facts.quote: With Local Services Ads, you only pay for customers — not clicks.

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers on Local Services Ads are charged only when potential customers get in touch through their ads.
facts.quote: Only pay when potential customers get in touch through your ads on Local Services Ads, so you can focus on real results for your business.

facts.fact: Google's page lists Electrician, HVAC, Plumber, Roofing, and Locksmith among the home services eligible for a Google Verified badge.
facts.quote: View the list of home services eligible for a Google Verified badge.

facts.fact: Google's page lists Real estate agent and Personal injury lawyer among the business services eligible for a Google Verified badge.
facts.quote: View the list of business services eligible for a Google Verified badge.

facts.fact: Google's page lists Dentist, Optometrist, and Primary care among the health services eligible for a Google Verified badge.
facts.quote: View the list of health services eligible for a Google Verified badge.

facts.fact: For learning services, Local Services Ads charges only when high-quality leads are received through the ads, not per click.
facts.quote: Only pay when you get high-quality leads through your ads on Local Services Ads, so you can focus on real results for your business.

facts.fact: Google states that a sign-up offer's Ads credit is issued only after the advertiser meets the minimum spend requirement for the selected offer.
facts.quote: You’ll receive your Ads credit after you meet the minimum spend requirement for the offer you selected.

facts.fact: Advertisers choose a monthly budget for Local Services Ads and can adjust it whenever needed.
facts.quote: Choose the budget that works for your business and adjust your monthly budget whenever you need to.

facts.fact: Google verifies each Local Services Ads business through checks on business registration and identity verification during screening.
facts.quote: Google verifies your business which includes checks on your business registration and identity verification.

facts.fact: Local Services Ads go live with a call or message button so customers can contact the business with one tap.
facts.quote: Your local advertisements will go live with a call or message button so customers are only a tap away.

facts.fact: Eligibility for the Google Verified badge applies to specific service categories, with a published list of eligible services for each category including learning, care, wellness, beauty, and automotive.
facts.quote: View the list of learning services eligible for a Google Verified badge.
